new_failure.observed_service_order: The previous poll is at 3099. The next tick is 3100. Stop submits one accepted Disconnect before poll detects expiry.
new_failure.observed_cancel_race: A successful connection event at or after the original stop deadline submits Disconnect before the next poll detects expiry.
